note: Authored Climate Season values, keyed by record name, read by api/cron/reference-climate.js. Twelve comma-separated tokens per record, Jan to Dec, each one of best, shoulder or off. A record with no entry here is never written: the fill refuses to convert a record it cannot complete, because two of the three climate fields is the half-converted state the 26 Aug 2026 audit found worse than leaving a record alone.
whyAuthored: Season is not derivable from climate data. A warm-and-dry rule was written and then measured against the 166 city records a human had already filled: 59.7% month-level agreement, 5 of 166 matching in full. It failed systematically rather than randomly, calling northern European city-break springs off for not being beach-warm, calling every Caribbean month off on rainfall, and inverting ski seasons exactly. The field encodes destination type, school holidays and crowds, so it is written by hand.
source: Each value below is authored from the written climate summary that record used to hold, archived at docs/climate-archive/cities-climate-prose.json. Those summaries usually state the season outright, which is why they were worth keeping.
